newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo travels to United States.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo travels to United States.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo travelled to the United States on Sunday for a two-day visit to New York, where he is slated to meet with U.S. financiers and academics.
Official news agency Notimex reported that Zedillo left Mexico on Sunday afternoon and was due back early on Tuesday.
The Yale-educated leader, 44, was slated to attend a breakfast on Monday at the Council of Foreign Relations, an organisation that promotes the study of U.S. foreign policy.
Zedillo is then scheduled to meet with journalists and representatives of international financial organisations later on Tuesday, Notimex said.
